definitions.short: honour ; used (figuratively) for the capital city (Jerusalem)
definitions.full: H1925. heder הֶ֫דֶר noun [masculine] ornament, adornment, splendour , only construct ׳ה מַלְכוּת Dan 11:20 splendour of (the) kingdom , compare AV RV, i.e. Judaea, or perhaps Jerusalem according to Leng Hi Meinh; but rather royal splendour , compare Gr, & especially Bev who reads ה מַעֲבִיר ׳נוֺגֵשׂ (for HCT נוגשׂ מעביר ), i.e. an exactor who shall cause the royal splendour to pass away .
